# Legacy Vercel prototype

This project now publishes the React app and multiplayer service to Cloudflare. Follow the [first hosted playtest guide](../docs/deployment.md).

The last successful Vercel prototype deployment can remain available during testing. The repository's current `vercel.json` disables automatic Git deployments. The root prototype is available in history with `git show 0e78756:index.html`. [Vercel Git configuration](https://vercel.com/docs/project-configuration/git-configuration#turning-off-all-automatic-deployments)

If GitHub still requires a historical Vercel check, the repository owner can update that check in the relevant ruleset to **Verify Meow Table / verify**. Any public URL change happens after the hosted playtest.
